commitMessage: don't rely on array type covariance
dslRule:
java.text.MessageFormat.format($message, new java.lang.String[] { $args$ })
=>
java.text.MessageFormat.format($message, new java.lang.Object[] { $args$ })
;;
summary: Replace `new String[] { ... }` with `new Object[] { ... }` when passed as an argument array to `MessageFormat.format()` to avoid reliance on array covariance and make the type explicit.

commitMessage: Fixed bug 321693: [preferences] Improve scroll bars in Errors/Warnings page
dslRule:
<!id: swt.controlListenerToAdapter>
<!description: Replace anonymous ControlListener implementations that explicitly define an empty controlMoved() method with ControlAdapter.>
<!severity: HINT>
new org.eclipse.swt.events.ControlListener() {
    public void controlResized(org.eclipse.swt.events.ControlEvent $e1$) {
        $body1$
    }
    public void controlMoved(org.eclipse.swt.events.ControlEvent $e2$) {
    }
}
=>
new org.eclipse.swt.events.ControlAdapter() {
    public void controlResized(org.eclipse.swt.events.ControlEvent $e1$) {
        $body1$
    }
}
;;
summary: Replaces an anonymous ControlListener implementation with an empty controlMoved() method body with a ControlAdapter for conciseness and style.
